title: Middle Eastern Skewers with Applesauce Glaze
description: Grilled Middle Eastern skewers served with a sweet and tangy applesauce glaze.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together Eastern spices blend, quenched yogurt, and vegetable oil.
3. Add crumbled pita bread to the bowl and mix until it forms a paste.
4. Thread festive onions, eastern bell peppers, and eastern spices blend mixture onto skewers.
5. Brush skewers with additional vegetable oil and season with Eastern spices blend.
6. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
7. While skewers are cooking, mix applesauce and 1 tsp Eastern spices blend in a small bowl.
8. Once skewers are done, let them rest for 2-3 minutes.
9. Brush applesauce glaze onto skewers and serve.
10. Garnish with additional Eastern spices blend, if desired.
